beaches.name: Melani
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on the northern part, beyond the rocks. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2007 to June 2019 describing that part as almost fully nude with free campers; no report newer than 2019 is documented.

beaches.name: Parisaina (Chorefto north)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the northern end, mixed with clothed campers. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from July 2016 and July 2021; the 2021 report says Tourkopigi beach, up the path beyond the north end, was used all nude.
